## Where is the problem?

Link the page, heading, example, or rustdoc item.

## What is inaccurate or unclear?

Describe what you read and what you expected to learn.

## Suggested correction

If possible, provide replacement wording or a minimal example. Do not include private calendar
data, credentials, or account identifiers.
